page.title: JVTO Police Integration & Safety Authority
page.summary: The founder's active Tourist Police commission — assignment orders, rank, and independent press confirmation — and what police-standard discipline means for your tour.

lede: JVTO's safety model is built around its founder's active Tourist Police (Ditpamobvit) commission. This page publishes the government-issued assignment orders and the independent press coverage that confirms the role.

sections.title: Official Police Assignment Documents
sections.body_md:
Two documents, both issued by the Indonesian National Police (POLRI) and both carrying SHA-256 hashes for forensic verification:

- **SPRIN-POLPAR — Tourist Police Assignment Letter.** Surat Perintah, Ditpamobvit. Issuer: Indonesian National Police (POLRI). SHA-256 `03c8578dc22956faa366d957badecfe38868d4760359cd8059fb2d6b145dfeab`.
- **SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL — Active Travel Order.** February 2024, Surat Perintah Perjalanan. Issuer: Indonesian National Police (POLRI). SHA-256 `179b061eae558943fdccc51d2ea3c8233a704b61f03ca3d212433f3e8d6f3bd3`.

Scanned copies are in the evidence locker above.

sections.title: Founder — Active Tourist Police Officer
sections.body_md:
**Bripka Agung Sambuko (Mr. Sam)**

- **Rank:** Bripka (Brigadir Polisi Kepala)
- **Unit:** Ditpamobvit — Directorate of Vital Object Security
- **Jurisdiction:** Kepolisian Daerah Jawa Timur (East Java)
- **Status:** Active duty (SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL Feb 2024)
- **Role:** Tourist Police operational safety oversight at Ijen Crater and East Java volcanic sites

The SPRIN POLPAR (Tourist Police Assignment Letter) and SPRIN WAL-TRAVEL (Active Travel Order) together establish that Agung Sambuko holds an active, government-issued police commission. Both documents are issued by the Indonesian National Police (POLRI) and carry SHA-256 hashes for forensic verification.

JVTO (PT Java Volcano Rendezvous) is a private tour operator. References to the founder's role as an active Tourist Police officer describe his personal professional background only; they do not represent or imply endorsement by the Indonesian National Police or any government body.

sections.title: What This Means for Your Tour
sections.body_md:
- **Police-standard discipline.** Ditpamobvit officers are trained in risk assessment, crisis response, and operational safety protocols — disciplines that transfer directly to managing tours in high-risk volcanic environments.
- **Authority, not just experience.** The Tourist Police commission is a government-issued operational authority. This is not a certification purchased from a private body — it is an assignment letter from the state.
- **Police escort available.** For large groups, a traffic police escort can be arranged via official channels. This is available on request — approval is not guaranteed and it is not automatically included in all tours.

items.question: Is the founder really an active Tourist Police officer?
items.answer: Yes. Bripka Agung Sambuko is an active POLPAR (Polisi Pariwisata) officer under Indonesia's Ditpamobvit (Directorate of Vital Object Security), POLRI. His identity was independently confirmed by Detik.com (March 2021 article naming him as Bripka Agung Sambuko). His current assignment is documented via SPRIN-POLPAR (Tourist Police Assignment Letter) and SPRIN-WAL-TRAVEL (active travel order, dated 12 February 2024). JVTO is a private operator; this describes the founder's professional background and does not imply government endorsement.

items.question: What is POLPAR and why does it matter for tour operators?
items.answer: POLPAR (Polisi Pariwisata) is the Indonesian Tourist Police unit under Ditpamobvit. Officers are formally assigned to secure and support tourism areas via a SPRIN (Surat Perintah / official order letter) from POLRI. Having an active POLPAR officer as founder means JVTO's safety protocols are not just guidelines — they are police-standard procedures applied to volcano tourism.

items.question: Can JVTO arrange a police escort for groups?
items.answer: JVTO can arrange a traffic police escort on request for larger groups, channelled through official channels. Approval is not guaranteed and it is not automatically included in all tours. See /travel-guide/police-escort-for-groups for the request flow and applicable group-size thresholds.
